sources.title: 鄭誠《斯卡奇科夫漢文滿文藏書目補注》665號俄藏《新編星學大成》五卷清抄本、題録224
sources.provider: Zheng Cheng, 2025 academic bibliography; modern full-text repost with identifying locator, cites Skachkov Chinese catalog and Lu Sijia 2020 thesis
sources.quality_notes: Entry 665 新編星學大成 5 (冊), 題録224; AR says 五卷, 萬民英, 清抄本, 1563 嘉靖四十二年自序. Per article, manuscript shelfmark Ф.274/224. Item itself not examined by this project, so do not assign physical-glyph authority, 1563 physical date, or claim Russian school transmission.

sources.title: 俄羅斯國家圖書館Скачков Ф.274手稿全宗官方書目（僅全宗級）
sources.provider: Russian State Library RSL Search official fonds record
sources.quality_notes: First-party RSL record Ф.274 identifies Skachkov fonds (XV-XIX centuries; historical collection) but does NOT itself attest the item-level 新編星學大成, the five-juan contents or manuscript folio glyphs. Item number derives from Zheng catalog rule; independent item record remains unresolved.

sources.title: 《千頃堂書目》卷十三星學大成十八卷受讀與陸位串列
sources.provider: Shidian received Qianqingtang bibliography volume 13; CTEXT received comparison
sources.quality_notes: 陸位星學綱目正傳二十卷，又星學大成十八卷; punctuation/author carryover requires physical edition collation; does not establish Lu Wei's original autograph, specific 18-juan copy or direct transmission. Separate from 15CA Siku General Catalog ten.

sources.title: 《明史》卷九十八志第七十四藝文三星學大成十八卷萬民英串列受讀
sources.provider: Xuoda Ming History full received text; alternative Ming Shi Yi Wen Zhi excerpt grouped under Lu Wei separately in comparison
sources.quality_notes: Received Ming Shi volume 98 line 萬民英三命會通十二卷星學大成十八卷, then 陸位星學綱目正傳二十卷; other MingShiYiWenZhi transcript associates eighteen with Lu Wei. Exact physical edition and compilation identity require separate study, no direct author verdict.

sources.title: 邵懿辰《四庫簡明目錄標註》星學大成十卷、明刊本與淡生堂目十八卷受讀
sources.provider: Shidian received Qing Shao Yichen annotated Siku simplified catalog
sources.quality_notes: Text states 星學大成十卷, 明萬民英撰; 明刊本; 淡生堂目十八卷. This is a Qing transmission of catalog data; does not prove Shao physically examined the Ming printing, or original Danshengtang entry glyph/which 18-volume item. Compare later copies and images independently.

RSL physical copy localization is cross-regional preservation, not school-level Russian transmission

Ming/Qing first-hand source-original bibliographic comparisons of Danshengtang, Qianqingtang, MingShi
